keyPoints: Gati (motion) ka matlab hai samay ke saath sthiti ka badalna.
Doori (distance) kul taya kiya gaya rasta hai; visthapan (displacement) shuru se ant tak ki seedhi doori hai.
Chaal (speed) = doori / samay; veg (velocity) = visthapan / samay (disha ke saath).
Eksam gati ke 3 samikaran: v = u + at; s = ut + 1/2 at^2; v^2 = u^2 + 2as.
Eksam vrittiya gati me disha lagatar badalti hai, isliye veg badalta hai aur tvaran hota hai.
Doori-samay graph ke dhelaan (slope) se chaal nikalti hai — seedhi rekha ka matlab eksam chaal.
